newsitem.title: USA: Generali unit settles with NY regulators.
newsitem.headline: Generali unit settles with NY regulators.

text.p: Assicurazioni Generali SpA's U.S. unit said on Tuesday it agreed to pay $1 million to the New York State Insurance Department, regarding a settlement over insurance issued by Generali to Bennett Funding Group.

State regulators had questioned whether Generali's U.S. unit's insurance of any shortfall in lease payments due to Bennett was financial guaranty insurance, which required a separate insurance license rather than credit insurance, Generali said.
Generali's Bennett Funding insurance program ended July 1, 1994 and Generali Underwriters, which placed the policy, was closed in 1993, the company said.
Premiums received by Generali in connection with the program were a small portion of its business, Generali said.
